# The functions TestNoTestReachesAHostThroughAnUnfakedSeam finds and does not
# require a guard from, one `file:function  # reason` per line. A row with no
# reason is refused: an exception nobody explained is one nobody can ever
# delete. The list is checked in both directions -- a listed function that is no
# longer a seam is a red run -- so it only shrinks.
